{{Quote|Ben&hellip;Ben, please! Ben. Leia! Hear me! Leia!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] calls for [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''Projective Telepathy''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Sense]]-based power used by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] to communicate with others at long distances and relay words without speaking. The recipient would be able to hear the sender, and feel their emotions. The process was easier if the recipient and the sender were emotionally close.<ref name="RPG" />

==Description==
It combined the perceptual abilities of Sense with the more direct discipline of Alter, allowing the Force-sensitive to put one's voice into the mind of another. This was however quite difficult to accomplish and even some members of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] did not achieve this. It was considered to be far easier to give a fellow Jedi a general "warning" sense than to convey a detailed message (including the number of attackers and the weapons each was carrying). Telepathic species such as the [[Hortek]] and [[Draethos/Legends|Draethos]] were naturally gifted in this skill.<ref name="JP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>
